name: @dome/brand
description: DoMe brand identity: vector logo sources traced from the owner's logo, BRAND.md, and the dependency-free export script that renders exports/

scripts.lint: xmllint --noout icon.svg icon-mono.svg mark.svg wordmark.svg wordmark-dark.svg wordmark-compact.svg wordmark-compact-dark.svg && ../mobile-app/node_modules/.bin/eslint .
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm export:check && pnpm sync:check
